name: Bordeaux
author: pierreggt
description: Map of the greater Bordeaux area (France), from Arcachon bay to Libourne and Langon. **1.1M OSM buildings** (binary format), **720k+ commuters** with demand built from real INSEE census data. Realistic traffic generators: Saint-Jean main station, Talence-Pessac university campuses (one demand point per real tram stop), Pellegrin hospital campus, Mérignac airport with runways and passenger flows, Arkéa Arena. Protomaps basemap with water and parks. Most trips are 2-10 km — calibrated for transit.
